verdict.conclusion: The compiled construction is a faithful continuous valuation on a genuine Hausdorff topological field with intrinsic value group isomorphic to (Q,+). Its group is not isomorphic to any Cartesian power of Z. This negates the final universal clause shared by the exact English and Chinese statements, so disproves their conjunction under the standard definitions explicitly stated in the report.

statement_bridge.english_assertion: the value group of a continuous valuation is a power of Z, with exponent the rank
statement_bridge.chinese_assertion: 连续赋值的值群为 Z 的幂且幂指数等于秩
statement_bridge.logical_form: A universal integer-power conclusion is a conjunct of the conjecture. One continuous valuation outside every integer power falsifies it; no answer about the other conjuncts is necessary.
statement_bridge.topology_convention: The original specifies no topology or discreteness hypothesis. The chosen topology is the standard valuation topology, and continuity is proved both to the standard order topology on the extended value group and to the finer topology that isolates finite values and has tails at infinity.
statement_bridge.power_convention: Z^I is the Cartesian product/function group I -> Z with pointwise addition. This includes every finite integer power, and the named obstruction theorem is universe-polymorphic in I. Forgetting any proposed order-preserving isomorphism would yield a forbidden additive isomorphism.
statement_bridge.rank_convention: No value of rank is assumed or formally assigned. Exclusion of every index type makes the rank choice unnecessary. The result does not separately formalize Krull rank, rational rank, or the conjecture's unspecified conversion formula and rank-jump assertions.

semantic_findings.detail: K is exactly HahnSeries Q Q with well-founded support (well-ordered under the linear exponent order), coefficientwise addition and standard Hahn convolution. Mathlib HahnSeries.instField proves inversion for every nonzero series. The field, topological division-ring and Hausdorff instances were independently elaborated.

HahnSeries.addVal Q Q is an AddValuation constructed from orderTop. It sends zero to top, one to additive zero, products to sums and satisfies min(w(x),w(y)) <= w(x+y). Its proof invokes order_mul for nonzero factors, with zero factors handled separately. No axiom or synthetic valuation predicate replaces these conditions.

AddValuation.toValuation is Equiv.refl on the valuation structure. ExtendedValue = Multiplicative (WithTop Q)^od is a linearly ordered commutative group with zero: zero represents additive infinity, multiplication is addition of exponents, and order reversal translates min to max. Independent definitional-equality checks linked valuation to HahnSeries.addVal and additiveValuation x to x.orderTop.

The inferred topology on K was checked definitionally equal to (Valued.mk' valuation).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace. The standard source gives neighborhoods at a by v(x-a)<gamma for invertible gamma, equivalently additive w(x-a)>q for rational q. It is a genuine Hausdorff topological field topology, not an arbitrary topology selected merely to force continuity.

Explicit independent checks established the first theorem with WithZeroTopology.topologicalSpace and the second with Preorder.topology ExtendedValue, with exactly the same domain topology. WithZeroTopology has singleton neighborhoods at nonzero multiplicative values and small-value neighborhoods at multiplicative zero. In additive notation these are isolated rationals and tails at infinity. Valued.continuous_valuation proves the local-constant and zero cases; the separate order-topology proof checks inverse images of both families of open rays. Reversing the order leaves the order topology unchanged.

valueHom maps Additive K-units to their rational lowest exponent and is additive by order_mul; units ensure the zero-series default order is never used. valueHom_agrees ties this map to the valuation. mem_valueGroup_iff identifies its range exactly with finite values attained at nonzero field elements, with Units.mk0 proving the reverse direction. Thus the group under obstruction is the actual value group, not an inflated codomain.

HahnSeries.single q 1 is nonzero and has order/orderTop q for every rational q, including negative values. These witnesses prove realization and valueGroup=top, yielding valueGroupEquiv : valueGroup ≃+ Q.

If I is nonempty, a hypothetical additive isomorphism Q -> (I -> Z) has a preimage x of the constant-one function. Since x/2+x/2=x, any coordinate would satisfy 2z=1 in Z, impossible. If I is empty, the target is trivial and injectivity contradicts 0!=1 in Q. Composition with valueGroupEquiv transfers the obstruction to the intrinsic group.

rationals_not_integer_power and valueGroup_not_integer_power quantify over I : Type u for an arbitrary universe. The main bundle specializes to Type 0 and additionally explicitly states no natural rank r gives a group equivalence with Fin r -> Z. The named polymorphic lemma supplies the broader index-set claim. The theorem concerns a concrete valuation; the manual bridge from this witness to failure of the natural-language universal assertion is direct and has no omitted rank premise.

The full report was read. Its field construction, valuation identities, topology descriptions, local-constancy argument, image-group identification, group obstruction and final implication match the Lean definitions and named theorems. No numerical/symbolic auxiliary computation is mathematically required.
